Name: Duruznik's Vanilla Portraits
Author: Duruznik
Description:
Ever wanted a fresh look for all the villagers? Well, look no further! This mod includes my own twist on all the game's characters, drawn in a higher-res style that's part cozy, part cartoonish. Including all minor characters, additional outfits, the works.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570029-688251244.png[/img]

1. You will need to have [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b] [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b] [/url]installed. 
2. This is a hi-res mod, which means you'll need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813][b]Scale Up Unofficial[/b][/url] installed.
3. Simply download the file and drop it into your mods folder. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570258-1447226643.png[/img]

Find my other portrait mods here!

[b]                       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52562]Duruznik's Portraits for SVE[/url][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52562][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46344/46344-1789825568-627403574.png[/img][/url]

More mod support coming soon[size=3]![/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789609371-551493326.png[/img]

Should work fine with other mods that use Portraiture. My portraits will show up in the vanilla set. 

Probably incompatible with mods that change vanilla portraits using frameworks other than portraiture.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52562/52562-1789758777-1548795477.png[/img]
